notes.title: Climber Patch #3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/e2e8b7c6ca582250ac38da37d1d945534785d67a.png[/img]
[h3]Hello Climbers,[/h3]
        Our journey continues - Patch #3 was just deployed to improve the gameplay.

Thanks, y'all for the feedback delivered on Steam discussions, reviews, and our discord - keep it up!

Here are the changes:
[list]
[b][Manaslu][/b]
[*]Missing rock on the climbing wall on the right side route;
[*]Model improvement near the first checkpoint;
[*]After passing a snow land screen is flickering;

[b][Mount Everert][/b]
[*]On the ice wall between 8 and 10-point checkpoint icons were in different colors;
[*]First Camp and the tent texture;
[*]No stone texture near the starting point;

[b][Gasherbrum I][/b]
[*]Disappearing mountain texture next to the starting point;

[b][K2][/b]
[*]Mountain model improvement around the base camp;

[b][Other][/b]
[*] Hungarian localization tweaks
[/list]
If you have any issues feel free to send us game log files so we can investigate the problem:
C:\Users\{YOUR_USER_NAME}\AppData\LocalLow\A2Softworks\Climber Sky is the Limit"
to support@art-games.com

If you would like to localize Climber to your language just let us know!
[b]Stay tuned for the next updates.[/b]

[h3]Feel free to join our discord:[/h3]
[url=https://discord.gg/XSvDn5e3Zp][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/ea7740b3445b6de5a79ccebc2e2b9a14654bbb6b.png[/img][/url]


cheers,
AGS Team

notes.title: Climber Patch #2
Climber Patch #1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/7c712b56f411d6eac21d0eb3de1936f664bf3f1d.jpg[/img]
[h3]Climbers,
First brave players experienced this breathtaking view and huge adrenaline.
But also encountered obstacles on some mountains. 
Thus we have prepared a patch based on the content some players posted through Steam discussions, reviews, and our discord.[/h3]

We have read all your comments, suggestions, and feedback with the dev team. And based on that we work hard to fix all issues you have encountered.

[b]Here is the list of fixed bugs:
[list]
[*] after falling the Mount Everest you respawned in a base camp;
[*] glitch on Mount Everest while climbing;
[*] blocking issue near checkpoint 8 on Mount Everest;
[*] tunnel sliding issue on Mount Everest;
[*] improved rock models on Manaslu;
[*] improved climbing mechanics in general;
[/list][/b]

If you have any issues feel free to send us game log files so we could investigate the problem:
C:\Users\{YOUR_USER_NAME}\AppData\LocalLow\A2Softworks\Climber Sky is the Limit"
to support@art-games.com

If you would like to localize Climber to your language just let us know!

notes.title: 3 DAYS TILL THE RELEASE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36776987/e8bfbec51727eec02ffc81eb83a8cdcb7841747a.jpg[/img]
[h3]Climbers, the Final day is coming relentlessly... 
Tutorial and five mountains are waiting![/h3]

[i]Challenge accepted[/i] - said Climber to eight-thousanders staring and smiling at him during this winter season. 

Here is a sneak peek: After the Free Trial this year, we have added new mountains as well as many new mechanics. Thanks to all PLAYERS - we have managed to implement [b]leaderboards[/b], [b]oxygen masks[/b], [b]detecting the snow crevasses[/b], [b]mountain news[/b], etc. 

[b]Many issues occurred during our journey but we pushed the summit. 
Now we're just waiting for you guys! [/b]

So pack your backpack and upgrade your gear to push the summit on Monday 21st November 2022. 
Hopefully, we might have the best of both worlds - a release discount and a Steam Autumn Sale. 

Fingers crossed! 
AGS Team

notes.title: Climber: Sky is the Limit - Free Trial Hotfix 1.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42349659/3992848e659bf6da035ea926dc92d8da1257c58e.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Hello Climbers![/b]
[b]Thank you for your amazing reception and feedback![/b][/h3]

[b]If you haven't played the Free Trial try here: [/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1963500/Climber_Sky_is_the_Limit__Free_Trial/

We looked through each review and Steam discussion with a detailed approach. 
We actively monitor feedback on social media as well as Discord, Steam reviews, and Discussions.

Thanks to it we were able to react to your most common problems with this first Climber: Sky is the Limit - Free Trial Hotfix!

[b]What was changed: [/b]
- Overall game difficulty lowered, now it should be a bit easier to summit Manaslu!
- Ladder balance is no longer tied to games FPS. 
- Polish is no longer the game default language 
- Fixed the black screen bug that was happening after the studio's logo. 
- Fixed the translation bugs
- Japanese text now fits space better and is easier to read
- Fixed options menu bugs that caused texts to overlap each other 
- some minor bugs fixed

Thanks to your engagement on Steam and our Discord.
[b]Each review, each feedback either positive or negative means a lot to us.[/b]


Join our Discord server to chat with us, take part in some Climber contests, and more:
[url=https://discord.gg/XSvDn5e3Zp][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42349659/ba091f900f0552de1167bbe4430dfe018c5caa62.png[/img][/url]
